Notes / substitutions: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W. This kit includes the short USB cable the build routes inside the case.
A PiSugar sized for the Pi Zero 2 W. Gives live battery state in adminTAK.
The 54x50 mm cell is sized to fit the custom Scout case.
Any A1/U3 card runs digiTAK. For offline maps (mbtileserver) size up: ~64 GB holds one map region ~512 GB the full map set.
Male-USB panel mount that mates the cable included with the Pi bringing data to the case wall. The 23.7 mm barrel matches the 3D-printed case cutout.
Panel-mount USB-C charge port at the case wall. The 23.4 mm barrel matches the 3D-printed case cutout.
A very small 5V supply that installs inside the charge panel mount to power the Pi.
Mates the other end of the charge cable.
About 6 in of 20-24 AWG silicone wire for the charge run. Any equivalent works.
M3 heat-set inserts for installing the covers.
2.5 mm plastic screws to mount the Pi to the PiSugar and the case.
3 mm stainless machine screws that thread into the heat-set inserts to close up the case.
Bridges an amateur (VHF/UHF) radio for digiTAK. Sold direct at digirig.net.
Short shielded USB-C cable for the digirig - keeps RF off the data line.
The same fast-fix GPS as the other builds - no jumper wires needed on the Scout.
